controls.subsequentExecutableOutcomes: unavailable; none inferred from silence, OHLC or later peaks

overlap.warning: overlapping 60-second windows and repeated token observations are not independent trials or independent minutes

unavailableSummary.reason: missing independent readiness/audit or invalid feature reproduction; excluded rather than treated as predictive failure
unavailableSummary.historicalVersionCaveat: Older versions lacked this independent diagnostic. Its absence is not itself a current implementation defect or proof the historical snapshot was independently verified.

limitations: This selected POE population cannot estimate independent whole-market winner recall or false-negative rate.
No historical data is backdated into a decision; every comparison uses the same recorded availability time and ten-second cadence.
Earlier-age shadow cannot recover pre-admission/pre-eligibility flow that POE did not collect. Any unseen four-to-five-minute opportunities remain unassessable.
No additional quote is fetched and no financial, execution, support or risk qualification is inferred from predictive passes.
Quiet assessed controls are not proof of losing or unprofitable tokens; no paired actual-size future execution path is available for economic ranking.
The frozen predicates are evaluated once per accepted token/window/run; overlaps and repeated visits remain correlated.
No parameter search, baseline mutation, production deployment or financial permission change is performed.
